title: Persistent Cookie
body:
A [[Cookies|cookie]] carrying an `Expires` date or a `Max-Age` duration. The browser writes it to disk and keeps it in the [[Cookie Jar]] until that moment passes, so it survives closing and reopening the browser.

This is what a "remember me" checkbox actually sets, and what analytics and ad-tracking cookies are — the ones that let a site recognise a returning visitor days later. Expiry is enforced by the browser, and setting an `Expires` date in the past is the standard way for a server to delete a cookie.

Contrast with a [[Session Cookie]], which has no expiry and is discarded when the browser closes.
